descriptions.w3d_d27k_net_message_8021a768: Message handler: disconnect ids dispatch the flagged property and set forced/active; other ids call 0x8021b0a8 or 0x8021a704, post a message, send the serialized team to the looked-up service and reset the timers, or reset the connection, store state 16, set the shared flag and call the base handler.
